title: LORD, I HEAR OF SHOWERS OF BLESSING
author: William B. Bradbury
stanzas: Lord, I hear of show'rs of blessings, Thou art scatt'ring full and free; Show'rs the thirsty land refreshing, Let Thy mercy fall on me!
Pass me not, O gracious Savior, Let me live and cling to Thee; I am longing for Thy favor, Whilst Thou'rt calling, O call me!
Love of God, so pure and changeless blood of Christ so rich, so free Grace of God, so strong and boundless Magnify them all in me.
chorus: Even me, even me. Even me,  even me. Let Thy mercy now fall on me!
